# Pinned exactly, with hashes, for spec-ci.yml's full draft-2020-12 validation.
#
# REQ-SEC-013 forbids floating versions, and it does not carve out CI tooling: a
# validator that changes under us turns a fixture corpus into a moving target,
# and "the schema was valid last week" is not a property anyone can act on.
# --require-hashes makes the pin cryptographic rather than nominal.
#
# Refreshing these is a deliberate act: bump the version, refetch the hash from
# PyPI, and let spec-ci re-run the whole corpus against the new validator. If a
# fixture verdict changes, that is the news, and it belongs in a commit message.
#
# Nothing here ships. This is the validator CI checks the schemas WITH; the
# validator the application uses is tools/theme-validate, built from our own
# hardened parser (desktop/src/core/json/), and the two are held to the same
# corpus on purpose — see .github/workflows/spec-ci.yml.
#
# Platform note: rpds-py is the one wheel here that is not pure Python, so its
# hash is for cp312 manylinux x86_64 — matching setup-python 3.12 on
# ubuntu-24.04. A runner change needs the matching wheel hash added.
#
# Expect Dependabot to widen that. Its requirement replacer asks the index for
# every hash of the new version, so a bump will probably arrive with the full
# wheel set rather than the one line above. That is more correct, not less — but
# it is a diff to read rather than approve on sight. See .github/dependabot.yml.

jsonschema==4.26.0 \
    --hash=sha256:d489f15263b8d200f8387e64b4c3a75f06629559fb73deb8fdfb525f2dab50ce

attrs==26.1.0 \
    --hash=sha256:c647aa4a12dfbad9333ca4e71fe62ddc36f4e63b2d260a37a8b83d2f043ac309

jsonschema-specifications==2025.9.1 \
    --hash=sha256:98802fee3a11ee76ecaca44429fda8a41bff98b00a0f2838151b113f210cc6fe

# referencing 0.37.0 uses `TypeVar(default=)` (PEP 696) unconditionally, which
# is a Python 3.13 feature — the first CI run died on it under 3.12. 0.36.0 is
# the last release that falls back to typing-extensions below 3.13, which is
# what CI runs, so it is pinned here with that fallback listed explicitly.
referencing==0.37.0 \
    --hash=sha256:381329a9f99628c9069361716891d34ad94af76e461dcb0335825aecc7692231 \
    --hash=sha256:44aefc3142c5b842538163acb373e24cce6632bd54bdb01b21ad5863489f50d8

typing-extensions==4.16.0 \
    --hash=sha256:481caa481374e813c1b176ada14e97f1f67a4539ce9cfeb3f350d78d6370c2e8 \
    --hash=sha256:dc983d19a509c94dba722ee6abd33940f7c05a89e243c47e907eb4db6f1a43e5

rpds-py==2026.6.3 \
    --hash=sha256:ecabd69db66de867690f9797f2f8fa27ba501bbc24540cbdbdc649cd15888ba6
